title: The Typewriter of Nagasaki's harbor
author: F. M. Okafor
blurb: Paloma Blackwood, an apprentice clockmaker summoned to repair the observatory's master clock, keeps a low profile and busy hands. Then a child is left at the door with instructions to forget the face — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must keep a promise made in peacetime to someone now declared enemy before the ship sails on the morning tide.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
